Title: Salesforce Developers URL Source: http://developer.salesforce.com/builtwitheinstein Markdown Content: # Showcase your agent-first business solution #BuiltWithAgentforce. ## Share a video of your own innovative Agentforce use case. Envision Agentforce solutions that would benefit a business from your industry or other sectors. Build your own agent and extend it by creating one or more custom actions using Flow, Apex, or a prompt template. Alternatively, build an agent that leverages Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to harness the power of unstructured data, such as in PDFs. Learn more ![Image 1: Social media post from Allen Chen about what he built with Einstein Copilot](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/einstein-copilot-post.png) ![Image 2](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/copilot-bush.png)![Image 3](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/copilot-rocks.png) ## Explore use cases from Salesforce experts. Learn how to use Agentforce to build limitless agents that take action across your business 24/7. ### Copilot Builder in Action Watch Salesforce Principal Developer Advocate, Philippe Ozil, use Copilot Builder to generate a discount code and follow-up email to his customer account. ### Prompt Builder in Action See Salesforce Principal Developer Advocate, Alba Rivas, use Prompt Builder to generate unique social media posts for properties for sale. ### Prompt Builder in Action Check out Salesforce Admin Evangelist, Josh Birk, use Prompt Builder to write a prompt that can summarize an account, its opportunities, and contacts. ## Showcase your agent-first business solution #BuiltWithAgentforce for a chance to win. Now is your opportunity to showcase your own innovative Agentforce use case for a chance to win* a TrailblazerDX pass or Agentblazer hoodie. Get creative and take your Agentforce skills to the next level with the new #BuiltWithAgentforce Quest. Take the Quest *No purchase necessary. Void where prohibited. The #BuiltWithAgentforce Quest Sweepstakes runs from November 13, 2024 9:00 a.m. PT to December 31, 2024 6:00 p.m. PT. Country of residence and other restrictions apply. Must be 18+. See [Trailblazer Quests page](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/quests) for full details and restrictions. ![Image 4: Einstein looking through binoculars](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/einstein-binoculars.png) ![Image 5](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/footer-graphic-large-2.svg) ![Image 6: Salesforce](https://a.sfdcstatic.com/digital/one-trust/core/stable/consent/8e783e8c-0ad0-475d-8fca-4a03afa0a02a/01938ba0-2bc1-7129-9a4c-e70d4380975d/logos/ddb906c9-f57b-40fc-85a1-c8bcbc371b0d/6a33a761-886e-4860-8e17-abc0832f7a62/corporate_logo_big.png) ## Cookie Consent Manager * ### General Information * ### Required Cookies * ### Functional Cookies * ### Advertising Cookies #### General Information We use three kinds of cookies on our websites: required, functional, and advertising. Title: Discussion Forums Migration FAQs | Salesforce Developers URL Source: http://developer.salesforce.com/developer-forums-migration-faq Markdown Content: ## Join Salesforce Developers in the Trailblazer Community. ![Image 1](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/salesforce-trailblazers-community-header-widescreen.svg)![Image 2](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/salesforce-trailblazers-community-header.svg)![Image 3](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/salesforce-trailblazers-community-flourish.svg)![Image 4](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/salesforce-trailblazers-community-flourish-tablet.svg)![Image 5](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/salesforce-trailblazers-community-flourish-mobile.svg) In December 2023, we moved the discussion forums formerly located on the Salesforce Developers website to the [Trailblazer Community](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/trailblazer-community/feed). But not all discussions moved over [(see the FAQs below)](http://developer.salesforce.com/developer-forums-migration-faq#faq), so if you can't find what you're looking for, then feel free to start a new discussion! The community will appreciate your contributions. ![Image 6](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/salesforce-trailblazers-faq-flourish.svg)![Image 7](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/salesforce-trailblazers-faq-flourish-tablet.svg)![Image 8](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/salesforce-trailblazers-faq-flourish-mobile.svg) View Group View Group View Group View Topic View Topic View Topic

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM (customer relationship management) platform. We bring companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by agentic AI and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and IT, work as one. You can learn more about what Salesforce is and what Salesforce does by visiting our official resources . Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads, close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic platform. What is CRM and why do I need one? CRM stands for customer relationship management. It’s a technology for managing all your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system helps you: • Organize contact information, leads, and customer service data • Automate tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails • Analyze data to understand customer behavior and business performance A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you a single , 360-degree view of every customer , allowing you to build stronger, more profitable relationships at scale. What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce? Agentic AI refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act autonomously to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike traditional AI that only generates content or analyzes data, agentic AI can reason, plan multistep actions, and execute tasks. In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our Agentforce technology — is used to: • Automate complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution • Predict business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close • Personalize every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels How does Salesforce CRM help my small business grow? Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from startups and small businesses to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and scalable , allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for what you use and have an AI and CRM platform that can grow with your business. Salesforce Starter helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.

Explore all use cases Trusted AI, built-in Agentforce contains a powerful set of low-code guardrails and security tools that keep data secure, prevent abuse, and reduce hallucinated and biased responses. Agent Guardrails Agentforce Guardrails combine user-defined safeguards and Salesforce managed protections to foster trust and maintain control over agent behavior. Key mechanisms work in concert to prevent deviations from core instructions, block off-topic or inappropriate conversations, and mitigate risks such as hallucination, bias, or the dissemination of incorrect information. Data Protection The Einstein Trust Layer is a robust set of features and guardrails that protect the privacy and security of your data, improve the safety and accuracy of your AI results, and promote the responsible use of AI across the Salesforce ecosystem. With features like dynamic grounding, zero data retention, and toxicity detection, the Einstein Trust Layer is designed to help you unleash the power of generative AI without compromising your safety or security standards. Tell us about your business needs, and we’ll help you find answers. Contact us Agentforce Frequently Asked Questions What is an AI agent? AI Agents are autonomous, proactive applications designed to execute specialized tasks to help employees and customers. Agents use large language models ( LLMs ) to analyze and understand the full context of customer interactions or an automated trigger, then reason through decisions on the next steps autonomously. These agents generate responses that are consistent with your company’s brand voice and guidelines using trusted business data, including Salesforce CRM data, external data from Data 360 , and more. These agents are capable of operating 24/7 across various platforms like self-service portals and messaging channels, handling tasks proactively within set guardrails. When faced with complex issues beyond their scope, they can escalate the matter to human agents, ensuring that queries are resolved efficiently and accurately. How do you build AI agents? Businesses can build agents with Agent Builder using existing Agentforce 360 Platform tools to create standard and custom subagents and actions. You can use prompts grounded in trusted enterprise data. You can use Flows to create automations across any system. You can use MuleSoft API connectors to connect Agents to any system. And last, you can use your Apex & Javascript to create the custom code and business logic for your Agent. What types of AI agents are there? Businesses can create an agent for any role, any industry and to solve any use case. With Agentforce, it's ready to spin up out-of-the-box agents across service , sales , marketing , commerce , and more. Service Agent replaces traditional chatbots with AI that can handle a wide range of service issues without preprogrammed scenarios, improving customer service efficiency. Sales Development Representative (SDR) engages with prospects 24/7, answering questions, managing objections, and scheduling meetings based on CRM and external data, allowing your sellers to focus on building deeper customer relationships. Sales Coach provides personalized role-play sessions for your sales team, using Salesforce data and generative AI to help sellers practice pitches and objections tailored to specific deals. Merchandiser assists your ecommerce merchandisers with site setup, goal setting, personalized promotions, product descriptions, and data-driven insights, simplifying daily tasks. Buyer Agent enhances the B2B buying experience, helping your buyers find products, make purchases, and track orders via chat or within sales portals. Personal Shopper acts as a digital concierge on your ecommerce sites or messaging apps, offering personalized product recommendations and assisting with search queries. Campaign Optimizer automates the full campaign lifecycle, using AI to analyze, generate, personalize, and optimize marketing campaigns based on business goals. Agentforce (formerly Einstein Copilot) supports employees in the flow of their work with specific tasks by searching for data, creating action plans, and executing them to increase workplace efficiency. How does Einstein work? Einstein is natively embedded into the Agentforce 360 Platform and leverages data from CRM and external applications to provide insights, predictions, and generated content directly in the flow of work. What is an AI agent builder? An ai agent builder is a platform for building and customizing AI agents. With Agentforce, our low-code Agent Builder that makes it easy to customize out-of-the-box agents or build new agents for any role, any industry, or any use case using existing tools like Flows, Prompts, Apex, and MuleSoft APIs to configure their agents. Using Agent Builder, businesses can create a job to be done for their agent by defining subagents, writing natural language instructions within that subagent, and creating a library of actions for it to choose from. Users can also easily observe an agent’s plan of action and test their responses in Agent Builder. What is Agentforce? Agentforce is a proactive, autonomous AI application that answers questions, takes actions, and improves productivity. You can equip Agentforce with any necessary business knowledge to execute tasks according to its specific role. With Agentforce, customers can unlock a limitless digital labor force by leveraging autonomous AI agents that support their employees and customers 24/7. How does Agentforce work? Agentforce can reason through complex requests, safely retrieve accurate knowledge about your business, take action on your behalf, and scale across teams and departments. It starts with the Atlas Reasoning Engine, which breaks down the initial prompt into smaller tasks, evaluating at each step and proposing a plan for how to proceed until the complete answer or action is achieved. How much does Agentforce cost? Every Salesforce customer can get started with Agentforce for free, for any use case, with Salesforce Foundations. Our pricing options include Flex Credits, Conversations, or per-user licensing, designed to fit how and where you deploy AI. Intelligent Context Demo

Take a closer look at how agent building works in our library. Watch demos Get expert guidance. Launch Agentforce with speed, confidence, and ROI you can measure. See how Talk to a rep. Tell us about your business needs, and we’ll help you find answers. Contact us Agentforce Frequently Asked Questions What is an AI agent? An AI agent is an intelligent system that can get work done proactively and autonomously, meaning it doesn't require human input. Agents can be triggered by changes in data and automations. They can understand and respond to human conversation dynamically. And they rely on machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) to reason and handle a wide range of tasks, from answering simple questions to resolving complex issues. How is an AI agent different from a chatbot? Traditional chatbots require pre-determined conversation trees to respond to inquiries. In contrast, agents are dynamic. They can adapt to human language and conversation, and they have the ability to reason. They make sense of the conversation, build a plan to address it, understand the tools available to them, and then take the best course of action. What can an AI agent be used for? You can customize an AI agent to fit any use case and any industry. Salesforce offers a range of out-of-the-box agents for service, sales, marketing, and commerce, so you can get started in minutes. These are just some examples of how agents can support your business: Service agents can automatically help a customer troubleshoot an issue with personalized, branded advice based on their purchase history and company knowledge documents SDR agents can send a personalized introductory email to a lead, respond to a question on pricing, and access an account executive’s calendar to schedule a follow-up call Marketing agents can generate campaigns, briefs, audience segments, emails, and end-to-end journeys based on your company's goals Ecommerce agents can manage your websites and generate personalized promotions How secure is Agentforce? The Einstein Trust Layer protects customer data through robust security features and guardrails, like zero data retention, toxicity detection, secure data retrieval, and dynamic grounding. It improves the safety and accuracy of outputs while ensuring the responsible use of AI agents across the Salesforce ecosystem. For example, the Audit Trail feature provides the data you need to track AI agent actions and outputs, ensuring AI usage complies with your organization’s security, privacy, regulatory, and AI governance policies. Can I customize Agentforce workflows? While other agent platforms require complex data integration and custom automation builds, Agentforce is already built into the Agentforce 360 Platform. You can instantly turn your existing workflows, prompt templates, Apex, and APIs into agent actions — with the added power of native tools, like Data 360, Slack, and MuleSoft. Agent Builder enables Salesforce admins and developers to use natural language to create jobs to be done, instructions, actions, and guardrails for their agents. What platforms does Agentforce integrate with? Agentforce is deeply integrated with the Agentforce 360 Platform, which brings together all the data and context agents need from internal and external sources, with the Einstein Trust Layer built in. This enables agents to take accurate, relevant actions, which are faster to implement thanks to our low-code framework. You can reuse Platform tools like flows and Apex, and build your agent on top of them. Agentforce also connects to all the channels where your employees and customers already interact, including CRM, WhatsApp, Messenger, and your website. There’s no need to go to another application to talk to an agent because they're bringing value to the existing flow of work. Is Agentforce suitable for small businesses? Agentforce is suitable for businesses of any size. Salesforce customers can now try Agentforce for free with Salesforce Foundations, a $0 add-on for Enterprise Edition and higher. Foundations helps businesses get ready for AI by extending their CRM with additional key features from Agentforce, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, and Data 360. Foundations now includes credits to power the first 1,000 conversations with Agentforce for Service, allowing your company to try its capabilities before buying.

## [264] Agentforce Supply Chain | Salesforce
Source: https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/agentforce-supply-chain/

Agentforce Supply Chain | Salesforce Skip to content Agentforce Supply Chain Reinvent back-office processes for speed, automation, and accuracy Agentforce Supply Chain uses AI-native technology to turn messy, manual processes into digital processes in minutes. Work is orchestrated across humans and specialized AI agents to save time and costs with enterprise-grade accuracy. Business users can continually improve processes on their own, without code or custom integrations. Talk to an expert Digitize manual processes in minutes, not months Get up and running quickly using natural language, docs, or diagrams Quickly create usable, repeatable blueprints for your processes in natural language, or by uploading unstructured data from a document or diagram. Digital blueprints are the single source of truth for humans and AI agents to see and know their roles, understand their tasks, and execute work. Blueprints can easily be fine-tuned as your needs evolve. No code required. Take advantage of our pre-built blueprint library If you don’t already have documented processes or want to streamline processes in new areas of your business, deploy immediately with 30+ pre-configured technical blueprints for Invoice Auditing, Supplier Onboarding, and Claims Processing. These are proven use cases that include industry best practices to deliver value fast. Run confidently with built-in trust and security Agentforce Supply Chain is built on the foundation of the Salesforce AI Trust Layer and Hyperforce, ensuring that enterprise-grade security and data sovereignty are inherent to every process. Beyond Salesforce’s standard security measures, like zero-data retention and end-to-end encryption, Agentforce Supply Chain includes deterministic guardrails and human in the loop so that every automated outcome is safe and contextually accurate. Orchestrate and automate work across humans and AI agents Deliver quick impact with pre-trained AI agents Specialized back-office agents come pre-trained with deep domain expertise so they can complete tasks within the context of your business automatically. For example, agents can extract data from invoices, check compliance rules, schedule dependencies, and complete complex computations. They act immediately and autonomously, eliminating wait times and increasing cycle times. Drive better processes with our orchestration engine The orchestration engine actively manages processes across humans, agents, and systems to get work done faster with data that was previously trapped in spreadsheets and email. The orchestration engine manages logic, monitors timelines, and escalates issues or delays to ensure compliance. Work with tools you already know Change management and adoption is seamless when users continue working within their existing tools — email, Slack, Excel, PDFs, and more. Process owners are empowered to thrive as value drivers with the agency to own and deliver high-impact business results without learning new tools. Improve processes continuously, without code Empower business users to drive process improvement with AI input AI suggests optimizations based on performance, feedback, and iteration. Then, business users can modify and improve processes themselves, without the need for developers, IT support, or building complex customizations. Get real-time visibility into processes Use dashboards to track and report progress or see workflow statuses. Automate alerts and notify the right people of updates, tasks, and issues wherever they work. Ready to take the next steps with Agentforce Supply Chain? Transforming Supply Chain Resiliency with Agentforce. Agentforce Supply Chain enables you to digitize and automate your processes Watch webinar Talk to an expert. Tell us about your business needs, and we'll help you find answers. Contact us Agentforce Supply Chain FAQ What is Agentforce Supply Chain? Agentforce Supply Chain is an AI-native solution that transforms back office business processes for better speed, automation, and accuracy. What is Regrello? Now named Agentforce Supply Chain, Salesforce completed its acquisition of Regrello on October 1, 2025. Bringing Regrello and Salesforce together is a key step toward realizing the vision of an agentic enterprise, where people and AI work together to achieve more than either could alone. What is supply chain automation? Supply chain automation uses software and artificial intelligence to improve the speed and efficiency of mid and back office processes like procurement, supplier onboarding, or warranty claims. By orchestrating work across people, systems, and vendors, companies move faster, operate more cost-efficiently, and scale with built-in control, quality, and visibility. How can agentic process automation help my business? Agentic process automation allows you to reinvent manual back-office processes in days rather than months by seamlessly connecting your data and operations. By enabling humans and intelligent automation to work together, you can drive faster cycle times and deliver highly accurate results at scale across your manufacturing and supply chain.

Get Started with Agentforce Developer Edition From the earliest days, Salesforce has empowered developers with agile development practices on our platform. Now comes Agentforce: a leap forward in modularity, agility, and collaboration for AI agent development. New developer tools from Agentforce revolutionize creating and managing intelligent agents with cutting-edge tools to thrive in the AI era. Seasoned developers and beginners alike can confidently configure, test, and deploy agents faster than ever with Agentforce. Access a comprehensive toolkit blending low-code development with pro-code flexibility. Build sophisticated agents by simply describing them in a few sentences, and if needed, dive into code for deeper customization. Agentforce enables developers of all skill levels to contribute to the creation of high-performing agents. Agentforce also provides advanced analytics to supervise, debug, and optimize agent performance in real time. Gain actionable insights into agent behavior, identify bottlenecks, and fine-tune your Agentforce configurations with data-driven guidance. To make experimentation even easier, we're excited to offer the Agentforce Developer Edition, a completely free environment to prototype agents and explore the power of Data 360. Ready to transform your agent development process? Dive into the Agentforce developer tools and discover a new era of efficiency and innovation. 1. Ideate and plan The foundation of any successful agent deployment lies in meticulous planning. Agentforce empowers you to start strong with the Agentforce Developer Edition , a free environment that allows you to prototype agents and explore the capabilities of Data 360. Leverage these tools to define your agent's purpose, map out workflows, and visualize the customer journey before writing a single line of code. 2. Build Agentforce quickly. Agentforce streamlines the building process with a suite of intuitive tools. Agent Builder with AI assistance helps teams to accelerate development - going from idea to fully formed Agentforce configuration just by describing what you want. Developers can also create , manage, and test Agentforce via Salesforce CLI and VSCode. The AppDev bar lets teams explore the metadata being created for seamless configuration. Integrate with MuleSoft Topic Center for robust connectivity and data orchestration. Whether you prefer low-code simplicity or pro-code flexibility, AgentforceDX provides the tools you need to bring your vision to life. 3. Test thoroughly. Ensure your agents perform flawlessly with Agentforce's comprehensive testing capabilities. The Testing Center provides a UI and API interface for running tests and identifying potential issues. Generate test cases, inspect potential responses, and understand how guardrails are being adhered to. With Agentforce, you can deploy with confidence, knowing Agentforce is ready to deliver exceptional experiences. 4. Deploy seamlessly. Agentforce integrates seamlessly with your existing DevOps workflows. Deploy agents directly from DevOps Center or leverage the CLI for command-line deployments. Enjoy a streamlined deployment process that minimizes disruptions and ensures your agents are deployed quickly and efficiently. 5. Supervise and optimize. The journey doesn't end with deployment. Agentforce provides powerful analytics tools to monitor and optimize agent performance. Agentforce Interaction Explorer is a powerful new tool for visualizing and analyzing how Agentforce is performing, how to optimize configurations, and detailed session data to debug individual interactions. Use these insights to refine your strategies, debug issues, and ensure your agents are consistently delivering exceptional results. Ready to take the next step with Agentforce? Build agents fast. Take a closer look at how agent building works in our library. Watch demos Get expert guidance. Launch Agentforce with speed, confidence, and ROI you can measure. See how Talk to a rep. Tell us about your business needs, and we’ll help you find answers. Contact us Agentforce Frequently Asked Questions What is an AI agent? An AI agent is an intelligent system that can get work done proactively and autonomously, meaning it doesn't require human input. Agents can be triggered by changes in data and automations. They can understand and respond to human conversation dynamically. And they rely on machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) to reason and handle a wide range of tasks, from answering simple questions to resolving complex issues. How is an AI agent different from a chatbot? Traditional chatbots require pre-determined conversation trees to respond to inquiries. In contrast, agents are dynamic. They can adapt to human language and conversation, and they have the ability to reason. They make sense of the conversation, build a plan to address it, understand the tools available to them, and then take the best course of action. What can an AI agent be used for? You can customize an AI agent to fit any use case and any industry. Salesforce offers a range of out-of-the-box agents for service, sales, marketing, and commerce, so you can get started in minutes. These are just some examples of how agents can support your business: Service agents can automatically help a customer troubleshoot an issue with personalized, branded advice based on their purchase history and company knowledge documents SDR agents can send a personalized introductory email to a lead, respond to a question on pricing, and access an account executive’s calendar to schedule a follow-up call Marketing agents can generate campaigns, briefs, audience segments, emails, and end-to-end journeys based on your company's goals Ecommerce agents can manage your websites and generate personalized promotions How secure is Agentforce? The Einstein Trust Layer protects customer data through robust security features and guardrails, like zero data retention, toxicity detection, secure data retrieval, and dynamic grounding. It improves the safety and accuracy of outputs while ensuring the responsible use of AI agents across the Salesforce ecosystem. For example, the Audit Trail feature provides the data you need to track AI agent actions and outputs, ensuring AI usage complies with your organization’s security, privacy, regulatory, and AI governance policies. Can I customize Agentforce workflows? While other agent platforms require complex data integration and custom automation builds, Agentforce is already built into the Agentforce 360 Platform. You can instantly turn your existing workflows, prompt templates, Apex, and APIs into agent actions — with the added power of native tools, like Data 360, Slack, and MuleSoft. Agent Builder enables Salesforce admins and developers to use natural language to create jobs to be done, instructions, actions, and guardrails for their agents. What platforms does Agentforce integrate with? Agentforce is deeply integrated with the Agentforce 360 Platform, which brings together all the data and context agents need from internal and external sources, with the Einstein Trust Layer built in. This enables agents to take accurate, relevant actions, which are faster to implement thanks to our low-code framework. You can reuse Platform tools like flows and Apex, and build your agent on top of them. Agentforce also connects to all the channels where your employees and customers already interact, including CRM, WhatsApp, Messenger, and your website. There’s no need to go to another application to talk to an agent because they're bringing value to the existing flow of work. Is Agentforce suitable for small businesses? Agentforce is suitable for businesses of any size. Salesforce customers can now try Agentforce for free with Salesforce Foundations, a $0 add-on for Enterprise Edition and higher. Foundations helps businesses get ready for AI by extending their CRM with additional key features from Agentforce, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, and Data 360. Foundations now includes credits to power the first 1,000 conversations with Agentforce for Service, allowing your company to try its capabilities before buying.

With Agentforce, agents can connect to any data source and use it in real time to plan, reason, and evaluate. And Agentforce agents can leverage any workflow, automation, or API to complete tasks. Read on to learn how it all works. Watch demos Talk to an expert Only Agentforce brings together humans + AI + data + action. Agentforce agents operate autonomously by retrieving the right data on demand, building action plans for any task, and executing these plans without needing human intervention. Using real-time data to adapt to changing conditions, they operate independently within your organization’s specific guardrails to ensure every customer interaction is accurate. Bring trusted data to your agents. Discover Data 360 Data 360 Data 360 gives agents real-time access to the data they need to do work, without the need to copy data from existing warehouses. Create powerful agents that refer to your connected structured and unstructured data. That includes company knowledge articles, CRM data, external data lakes, and more. Metadata Metadata allows agents to know the context of your business and the actions available to them. Metadata is a core part of the Agentforce 360 Platform: Every field, label, entry, and automation built on the platform is tagged with relevant metadata that Agentforce can read and understand. This metadata allows the agent to know exactly how to use a flow or what data it needs to pull in. Prompt Builder Prompt Builder lets you build repeatable, tailored prompts that can deliver the exact data an agent needs to do work. These prompts can be used by agents to find and retrieve structured and unstructured data in real time through Retrieval Augmented Generation. Learn more Agentforce learns and reasons with the Atlas Reasoning Engine. Advanced RAG The Atlas Reasoning Engine uses advanced techniques like ensemble retrieval augmented generation (RAG), which combines the strengths of several RAG models, to find highly specific, accurate data for agents. Agents can search across structured and unstructured data to find similar language to the initial task, giving them the knowledge they need to respond and act with precision. Agentic Loops The Atlas Reasoning Engine breaks down the initial prompt into smaller tasks, evaluating at each step and proposing a plan for how to proceed. For example, if an agent is handling a customer inquiry, it identifies the intent, searches for relevant data, creates a plan of action, and evaluates the effectiveness of the action. If unsatifactory, the agent continues to adapt and refine the plan by asking for additional information. This ensures that the initial prompt can be completed accurately. Topic Classification The Atlas Reasoning Engine evaluates a user request against all of the topics available to an agent, and then selects the most appropriate one to accomplish the task. Agentforce takes action across your entire enterprise. Applications Agentforce is natively integrated with the entire Salesforce Customer 360. From Sales and Service to Commerce and Marketing, agents can use complete customer context from your CRM applications and take action directly within the flow of work for your employees. For example, an agent can use engagement data to identify an opportunity to upsell and generate a personalized email to a prospect. Conversations Agentforce can be embedded across web and mobile chat, email, SMS, and Slack to meet your customers wherever they are. Agents can reply natively, and also seamlessly handoff to human employees across any channel. For example, a customer can log onto your website and have a conversation with an agent to troubleshoot a broken item. The agent replies with best practices and trouble shooting instructions to close out the case. Workflows Agents can take advantage of prebuilt Flows to automate business processes. Agents can be configured to run Flows and use their output to help respond to the intial prompt. Agents can also be embedded within a Flow to help automate even more work. For example, an agent can run a flow to automatically elevate the priority of a customer case ticket based on certain criteria. Agentforce Activator. Confidently deploy agents fast. Work with the experts from Salesforce Professional Services and Certified Partners to create an agent tailored to your business goals and aligned with your values. Learn more Join the Agentblazer community. Connect with Agentblazers from around the world to skill up on AI, discover use cases, hear from product experts, and more. Grow your AI expertise — and your career. Join today Learn more Ready to take the next step with Agentforce? Build agents fast. Take a closer look at how agent building works in our library. Watch demos Get expert guidance. Launch Agentforce with speed, confidence, and ROI you can measure. See how Talk to a rep. Tell us about your business needs, and we’ll help you find answers. Contact us Agentforce Frequently Asked Questions What is an AI agent? An AI agent is an intelligent system that can get work done proactively and autonomously, meaning it doesn't require human input. Agents can be triggered by changes in data and automations. They can understand and respond to human conversation dynamically. And they rely on machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) to reason and handle a wide range of tasks, from answering simple questions to resolving complex issues. Learn more with AI agent courses . How is an AI agent different from a chatbot? Traditional chatbots require pre-determined conversation trees to respond to inquiries. In contrast, agents are dynamic. They can adapt to human language and conversation, and they have the ability to reason. They make sense of the conversation, build a plan to address it, understand the tools available to them, and then take the best course of action. Read the guide to learn more about AI agents vs. chatbots . What can an AI agent be used for? There are many AI agent use cases . You can customize an AI agent to fit any use case and any industry. Salesforce offers a range of out-of-the-box agents for service, sales, marketing, and commerce, so you can get started in minutes. These are just some examples of how agents can support your business: Service agents can automatically help a customer troubleshoot an issue with personalized, branded advice based on their purchase history and company knowledge documents SDR agents can send a personalized introductory email to a lead, respond to a question on pricing, and access an account executive’s calendar to schedule a follow-up call Marketing agents can generate campaigns, briefs, audience segments, emails, and end-to-end journeys based on your company's goals Ecommerce agents can manage your websites and generate personalized promotions How secure is Agentforce? The Einstein Trust Layer protects customer data through robust security features and guardrails, like zero data retention, toxicity detection, secure data retrieval, and dynamic grounding. It improves the safety and accuracy of outputs while ensuring the responsible use of AI agents across the Salesforce ecosystem. For example, the Audit Trail feature provides the data you need to track AI agent actions and outputs, ensuring AI usage complies with your organization’s security, privacy, regulatory, and AI governance policies. Can I customize Agentforce workflows? While other agent platforms require complex data integration and custom automation builds, Agentforce is already built into the Agentforce 360 Platform. You can instantly turn your existing workflows, prompt templates, Apex, and APIs into agent actions — with the added power of native tools, like Data 360, Slack, and MuleSoft. Agent Builder enables Salesforce admins and developers to use natural language to create jobs to be done, instructions, actions, and guardrails for their agents. What platforms does Agentforce integrate with? Agentforce is deeply integrated with the Agentforce 360 Platform, which brings together all the data and context agents need from internal and external sources, with the Einstein Trust Layer built in. This enables agents to take accurate, relevant actions, which are faster to implement thanks to our low-code framework. You can reuse Platform tools like flows and Apex, and build your agent on top of them. Agentforce also connects to all the channels where your employees and customers already interact, including CRM, WhatsApp, Messenger, and your website. There’s no need to go to another application to talk to an agent because they're bringing value to the existing flow of work. Is Agentforce suitable for small businesses? Agentforce is suitable for businesses of any size. Salesforce customers can now try Agentforce for free with Salesforce Foundations, a $0 add-on for Enterprise Edition and higher. Foundations helps businesses get ready for AI by extending their CRM with additional key features from Agentforce, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, and Data 360. Foundations now includes credits to power the first 1,000 conversations with Agentforce for Service, allowing your company to try its capabilities before buying.

Flex Credits are a new unit of payment for Agentforce that align cost to the business value your AI agents create. Each Action — a specific function that an AI agent executes on the platform, such as updating a record, summarizing a complex case, answering a product inquiry, or executing a custom prompt or flow — draws from a pool of Flex Credits. Flex Credits can be applied across teams, channels, and use cases, allowing you to expand your AI strategy without renegotiating pricing or forecasting volume. Each action is metered individually, so your investment aligns to the value delivered, not just the number of interactions. Agentforce actions are 20 Flex Credits, while Agentforce Voice actions are 30 Flex Credits. Flex Credits give you the control to experiment, optimize, and grow — with real-time insights into consumption through Digital Wallet. Examples of actions, in action. Contact us Agentforce Frequently Asked Questions How do I know if Flex Credits or Conversation pricing is the right model for my business? Flex Credits offer the most flexibility and scalability. Conversations offer flat-pricing, while Flex Credits align cost to value. Conversations are optimized for external facing customer agents, while Flex Credits scale across any Agentforce use case. While Conversation consumption will be viewable in Digital Wallet , Flex Credits in Digital Wallet will offer more granular usage data for the greatest insight and transparency. Flex Credits will offer additional flexibility with a choice of buying model options. Contact your Account Executive to learn more about what model might work best for your business and use case. Can I use both Flex Credits and conversation pricing at the same time? No. Flex Credits and Conversations will not be supported in the same org. What happens if I don’t use all my Flex Credits? Unused Flex Credits do not roll over into subsequent subscription terms. Work with your Account Executive to strategize on next steps. I have Conversation pricing, can I switch to Flex Credits? Yes. If you would like to do so to take advantage of the flexibility that Flex Credits offer, you will need to swap all of your existing Agentforce Conversation SKUs. Speak with your Account Executive to learn more about the process. Is Digital Wallet included, or do I have to purchase it? Digital Wallet will be automatically provided for free for any customers who have Digital Wallet enabled products. Digital Wallet supports all products sold with usage-based metrics. For Flex Credits, Digital Wallet will provide more granular usage insights and analytics. What happens if I exceed my Flex Credit balance? There is no overage penalty. If you exceed your entitlement, your rate is your contracted rate billed monthly in arrears. Prevent overages by using alerts in Digital Wallet. What products are available with the PayGo and PreCommit buying models? Only Flex Credits for Agentforce are available for purchase with PayGo and PreCommit models. Conversation-based pricing, Agentforce add-ons and Agentforce 1 Editions are not available with these models. How is Agentforce Voice priced with Flex Credits? For all Agentforce actions, Flex Credits scale up and down with usage to align cost to value. Usage types and multipliers differ for Agentforce Voice actions. See the Agentforce Rate Card for more detail.

Contact us Frequently Asked Questions What is an AI Agent? An AI agent is more than just intelligent software. It's designed to learn and adapt to user interactions autonomously. This flexibility and continuous learning capability enable it to drive efficiencies while providing increasingly better support and solutions, making digital assistants an invaluable tool for improving customer experiences. What are the benefits of Agentforce? Agentforce enhances customer success by enabling humans and AI agents to work together seamlessly. With Agentforce, you can build and customize autonomous AI agents to support your employees and customers 24/7, boosting efficiency, scalability, and satisfaction. What is conversational AI? Conversational AI enables machines to communicate with humans using natural language, facilitating interactions through chatbots, virtual assistants, and other automated systems to improve customer service and engagement.

Tailor agents to reflect your unique brand voice and provide consistent, trusted support. Talk to an expert Turn customer conversations into trusted experiences with Agentforce. Customers still prefer to talk when it matters most. With Agentforce Voice, you can build voice-enabled agents that manage complex conversations in real time — across phone, web, and mobile. Grow trust with a natural dialogue and strengthen customer relationships at scale with consistent, always-on support. Build once. Deploy voice everywhere. Salesforce-Native Voice Agents Agentforce Voice is native to the Salesforce platform. Voice-enabled agents use the same subagents, actions, and data that power your existing agents. That makes them more than conversational: They're context-aware, able to resolve tasks using your CRM, flows, and APIs. The result is a seamless customer journey that feels connected and efficient on any channel. Multi-Channel Deployment Engage customers with rich, interactive voice conversations wherever they reach you - on the phone, through click-to-talk on your website, or directly in your mobile app. By deploying once and scaling across channels, you can offer consistent service experiences that feel natural and response. This flexibility ensures customers always have access to the support they need, in the channel they prefer. Deliver natural, context-aware conversations. Conversations Grounded in CRM Data Personalize every interaction by granting your voice agents access to a complete view of the customer. That includes history, preferences, and past conversations, pulled directly from Salesforce. Grounding interactions in CRM data builds trust and long-term loyalty with every conversation. Ultra Low-Latency Interactions Deliver fast, natural conversations with a platform designed to respond in real time. Agentforce Voice combines advanced reasoning with ultra low-latency performances, so customers can speak without awkward delays. Tell us about your business needs, and we’ll help you find answers. Contact us Agentforce Voice FAQ What is Agentforce Voice? Agentforce Voice is an AI-powered voice agent that automates customer service interactions. It handles routine calls and provides instant, conversational responses, freeing up human agents to focus on more complex issues. How does Agentforce Voice differ from traditional IVR systems? Unlike traditional Interactive Voice Response (IVR) systems, Agentforce Voice uses natural language processing (NLP) to understand context, intent, and sentiment. This allows it to engage in fluid, human-like conversations rather than relying on rigid, pre-defined menus. Can Agentforce Voice be integrated with my existing CRM and business tools? Yes, Agentforce Voice integrates seamlessly with your existing CRM and other back-end systems. This allows it to access real-time customer data, update records, and trigger automated workflows to provide personalized and efficient service. How does Agentforce Voice handle complex customer issues? Agentforce Voice is designed to identify complex or emotionally charged situations. When a query is beyond its scope, it seamlessly transfers the call to a live human agent with the full conversation history and relevant customer context, ensuring a smooth and informed hand-off. What are common use cases of Agentforce Voice? Agentforce Voice is primarily used for customer service to handle inquiries and technical support. However, its capabilities extend to sales, with uses like lead qualification and appointment scheduling. It also improves internal operations by assisting with tasks like real-time sales coaching and knowledge retrieval for employees. What are the key benefits of using AI voice agents for business? AI voice agents offer 24/7 availability, consistent service quality, and increased scalability to handle high call volumes. They can significantly reduce operational costs and improve customer satisfaction by providing faster response and resolution times. How can AI voice agents enhance a human customer service team? Voice AI agents act as a force multiplier in your agentic enterprise , handling routine and repetitive inquiries. These AI agents free employees from mundane tasks, allowing them to dedicate their time and expertise to solving intricate problems, providing empathetic support, and building stronger customer relationships. What regions is Agentforce Voice supported in? Agentforce Voice is GA in all regions and available in English (US/UK). Additional language support will follow.

Agentforce has the missing systems you need to make AI agents real for your business. You can get started today with prebuilt agents or customize your own. Agentforce agents have built-in integration with your business data and processes. They learn and adapt as they navigate to the desired outcome, all while seamlessly collaborating with employees inside the business apps they already use. Talk to an expert You need more than a model for AI to do work reliably. A Large Language Model alone is not enough. AI requires many systems to make it accurate, secure, and capable of taking action in your business. But thankfully, Agentforce provides those missing systems so you don't have to build them. What if you could skip the setup and just start building your AI agent? Describe the AI agent you want and Agentforce will help make it real. Create custom agents with Agent Builder Simply type a natural-language description of the job you want your agent to do. Agent Builder will use an understanding of your business, powered by the metadata inside Salesforce, to auto-generate your first prototype. You can then easily monitor an Agent’s plan of action and test its responses right in Agent Builder. Customize with natural language Fine-tune your perfect agent with customization using natural-language instructions. These become the guardrails that direct your agent's behavior. This context helps your agent better understand the job it’s being asked to do. Extend with your existing business workflows Tap into the workflows and actions you’ve already built and optimized in Salesforce to expand the functionality of your agents. Equip your agents with those workflows to start working within your guidelines, from day 1. Enhance with AI-powered actions Add further actions to your agents with AI capabilities. Use Prompt Builder templates to customize actions and automatically assign jobs to other agents. Start experimenting today with prebuilt AI agents that work with your existing Salesforce data. Service Agent Start answering customer questions and deflecting incoming support cases by using a prebuilt template to create your first Agentforce service agent. Your Agentforce service agent will be instantly aware of your customer records, case records, and the answers contained inside in your knowledge articles inside Salesforce. Which enables it to immediately start answering customer questions. Sales Development Representative (SDR) Nurture inbound leads and advance your pipeline with an SDR agent. Your agent will autonomously answer product questions, handle objections, and schedule meetings for your reps. The agent will engage leads in any language on their preferred channels, like SMS or WhatsApp by referencing CRM and external data. Your guardrails control when and how often it engages. Sales Coach Practice pitching, handling objections, and negotiating with a sales coach agent that runs tailored role-plays. Get feedback on strengths, areas for improvement, and actionable steps based on CRM data, selling methodologies, and virtual meetings. Personal Shopper Offer AI-powered shopping assistance on commerce sites or messaging apps with your personal shopper agent. The agent uses CRM data to guide search and personalize product recommendations, boosting conversion rates. Customers can even add to their cart, check out, track orders, and receive updates without leaving the conversation. Campaign Assistant Build and launch campaigns faster with a campaign agent that can generate briefs, audience segments, content, and customer journeys. The agent personalizes 1:1 engagements at scale using real-time data and continuously analyzes performance, proactively recommending improvements to optimize KPIs and drive better results. Watch your agents learn and adapt with the Atlas Reasoning Engine. With each new job, your AI agents will use a cycle of observations, evaluations, recommendations, and execution to carry out a job, step-by-step, learning and adapting to reach the right outcome. Equip your AI agents with a deeper understanding of their job through advanced data retrieval. Built-in semantic search, vector databases, and RAG Dramatically improve the accuracy of your agents with a semantic search to retrieve similar content, across all your data, to get the job done right. This advanced data retrieval technique (Retrieval Augmented Generation) is built-in to Agentforce, available to any AI agent. Built-in access to your Salesforce CRM data Your agents will only be effective if they can tap into a much wider set of knowledge as they do work. The advantage of Agentforce agents is their built-in access to your CRM data, like customer information, opportunities, purchase and case history, campaigns, and more. Zero-copy external data access with Data 360 Agentforce agents also have built-in access to Data 360, so you can connect and harmonize all your external data without having to copy it. Plus, give your agents more context about what it all means with your metadata, the data about your data. Context about how the job was requested The who, what, and where behind an agent's job are critical to understanding it. Because Agentforce is built on the Agentforce 360 Platform and part of your Customer 360, your agents get a full view of the who behind the job. Each time you create an agent, you’re also establishing a role for your agent, which will give that agent more context about what the job is. As for where, your agents can be embedded in your website, your mobile app, WhatsApp, in your employee apps, or inside your businesses processes. Extend your security policies to AI agents with the Salesforce Trust Layer. Secure data retrieval and zero-retention All of your existing Salesforce security policies are automatically respected by your AI agents. You won’t need to recreate your existing security policies for AI. We’ve already negotiated zero-retention data agreements with our AI model partners, ensure that none of your data will ever be retained or used to enhance any AI results other than your own. Guardrails governed by you Your AI agents work inside the guardrails you establish to do jobs. They can reason intuitively to respond reliably to complex requests. More importantly, they will refuse to be lured outside those guardrails — or respond to any requests that might be inappropriate. Built-in harm and toxicity detection Agentforce automatically detects harm and toxicity when a request is inappropriate and will refuse to engage. Audit trails, feedback, and data masking The Trust Layer identifies and masks sensitive information in your prompts before sending them to the model, protecting sensitive data like PII from being exposed to external LLMs. Ensure the safety and accuracy of your agent by tracking the functionality of its data masking and toxicity detection. You can delete your AI audit and feedback data at any time. Ready to take the next step with Agentforce? Build agents fast. Take a closer look at how agent building works in our library. Watch demos Get expert guidance. Launch Agentforce with speed, confidence, and ROI you can measure. See how Talk to a rep. Tell us about your business needs, and we’ll help you find answers. Contact us Agentforce FAQs What makes Agentforce unique? Agentforce empowers businesses with autonomous AI agents that operate independently, adapt to real-time data, and seamlessly collaborate with human teams. Built on a low-code/no-code platform, Agentforce is adaptable to various industries and uses advanced AI capabilities to deliver accurate, efficient, and creative solutions. Is Agentforce secure? Agentforce utilizes Salesforce's robust security infrastructure, including the Einstein Trust Layer. This ensures data privacy and limits access to authorized personnel. Advanced security measures, like data encryption and strict access controls, further safeguard sensitive information. Salesforce also conducts regular security audits and adheres to industry standards to maintain a high level of security for Agentforce and its users. Do you need to know how to code to use Agentforce? No, you don't need to know how to code to use Agentforce. It's designed with a low-code/no-code approach, making it accessible to users with varying technical backgrounds. With its user-friendly interface, you can build and customize AI agents without writing complex code. That gives you the power to quickly deploy agents and use AI to automate tasks and improve efficiency. What are the practical applications of Agentforce? There are so many ways you can use Agentforce to streamline operations, boost productivity, and improve customer experiences. Some Agentforce use cases include: Automating customer support Simplifying sales processes Generating marketing content Optimizing internal workflows How much does Agentforce cost? Agentforce for Service and Agentforce are now generally available. Agentforce for Service pricing starts at $2 USD per conversation; standard volume discounts apply. What&#39;s the difference between Agentforce and Copilot/chatbots? While copilots and chatbots are valuable tools, Agentforce offers a more advanced level of AI. It empowers agents with greater autonomy, enabling them to handle a wider range of tasks independently. With advanced AI capabilities, Agentforce agents can provide more accurate, efficient, and creative solutions, ultimately delivering greater value to businesses. Learn more about the differences between AI agents vs. chatbots . Is Agentforce fully integrated with Salesforce? Agentforce is deeply integrated with the Agentforce 360 Platform, allowing AI agents to seamlessly access and interact with data across various Salesforce applications. This integration enables agents to use customer data, trigger workflows, and update records, making them a powerful tool within the Salesforce ecosystem.

Build the Future of AI Data 360 Governance: Protecting Your Data in the Agentic Landscape Learn to Protect Your Data Agentic AI Depends on Unstructured Data Unstructured Data Guide See more resources Frequently Asked Questions What is Data 360 ? Salesforce Data 360 (formerly known as Data Cloud) is the real-time data engine that powers the entire Salesforce platform. It unifies fragmented data from every source — including external data lakes, websites, and legacy systems — into a single, trusted "Customer 360" profile. By providing a "Zero-Copy" architecture, it allows your teams to access and act on massive amounts of data instantly without the need for complex moving or duplicating. It serves as the essential data foundation for Agentforce , ensuring your AI agents and automated workflows always have the most accurate, up-to-date customer context. What is the difference between Data Cloud and Data 360? Salesforce Data 360 is the official new name for what was previously called Data Cloud . How does Data Cloud pricing compare to the new Data 360 pricing? Data 360 is the new name for our comprehensive data platform, formerly known as Data Cloud. The pricing model remains a flexible, consumption-based approach centered around: 1) Consumption Credits, 2) Data Storage, and 3) Premium Add-ons. We have simplified our credit system to offer even more flexibility and transparency. I have an existing contract for Data Cloud. Do the Data 360 pricing updates affect my current agreement? Your existing Data Cloud agreement and pricing will be honored through the end of your current term. Your solution is now referred to as Data 360, but you will retain all contracted capabilities. Please contact your Account Executive to discuss renewal and transition options under the new Data 360 packaging. What are the benefits of Data 360? Data 360 allows you to unify all your data on Salesforce without building complex data pipelines, easily take action on all your data across every Salesforce Cloud, and enable trusted AI solutions powered by your data. What data sources can I integrate with Data 360? Data 360 allows you to ingest virtually any data source to activate data-driven decision making and a robust data strategy . Seamlessly connect your CRM apps, like Sales and Service Cloud, using Salesforce connectors. Leverage out-of-the-box connectors with common third-party sources, including Amazon S3 and Google Cloud Storage. Take advantage of our zero copy integrations to pull in data from your existing Data Lakes and Warehouses, like Snowflake and Data Bricks, without duplicating data. And for everything else you can connect using SDKs and APIs. How is Data 360 different from other data platforms, lakes, and warehouses? Unlike other data platforms that focus primarily on managing and organizing data, Data 360 was purpose-built to help companies take action on their data across everyday applications like Sales, Service, and Marketing Cloud. That's because Data 360 is natively integrated into the Salesforce metadata framework and enables all teams, not just IT, to move faster with data using low-code tools like Flow and Agentforce. Is Data 360 a data modeling tool? While Data 360 does offer data modeling capabilities, its primary focus is to serve as a tool for activating your data. The Salesforce data model is designed to help you easily integrate your data within the Salesforce metadata framework, turning data from any source into native objects and fields ready to use across all your Salesforce applications. How can Data 360 help me automate data-driven decision making? With all your data integrated into Data 360, you can start to automate tasks and make smarter decisions using all your company data. Sales teams can boost productivity and increase deal conversion rates by surfacing or building workflows with external data like purchase history or web engagement data. Service teams can improve customer satisfaction and reduce churn by giving agents access to external data like product engagement and device telemetry data. What types of insights can Data 360 help unlock for my organization? Businesses leveraging Data 360 can efficiently uncover insights by using their own models or our low-code insights builder, enabling teams to quickly derive key metrics such as Propensity to Buy, Customer Lifetime Value, and Engagement Scores for each customer. How does Data 360 pricing work? Data 360 pricing is consumption-based, meaning you pay only for the services you use. Can I try Data 360 before buying? Existing Salesforce customers can get started with Data 360 for free by visiting this page . How can I get started with Data 360? Existing Salesforce customers can access this guide to Getting Started with Data 360 . Try Starter Suite for free Frequently asked questions What is digital labor? Digital labor refers to technologies (such as AI automation and AI agents) that mimic human decision-making and cognitive abilities. It powers everything from lead nurturing to 24/7 customer support to campaign generation — extending human capacity at speeds and scales no human-only workforce can match. What is an Agentic Enterprise and what does it mean for my business? An Agentic Enterprise is a company where humans and AI agents collaborate seamlessly. Employees are enhanced by digital labor to boost productivity, unlock insights, drive results, and strengthen every customer relationship through trusted, data-driven experiences. This requires a deeply unified platform to deliver efficiencies that scale and customer success that lasts. What is the agentic era? The agentic era is a turning point in how work gets done. For the first time, AI doesn’t just respond to queries or perform simple repetitive tasks — it’s evolved to reason, adapt, and handle cognitive work once reserved for people. Employees gain digital partners that think, learn, and act alongside them — driving faster decisions, more personalized customer experiences, and productivity at a scale a human-only workforce could never achieve. How can my business become an Agentic Enterprise? Becoming an Agentic Enterprise starts with a clear vision and team alignment around your goals. From there, identify your initial high-impact use cases, transform your existing processes for humans and agents to work together, and build a trusted, unified data foundation that provides a single source of truth for every decision. By doing so, you can achieve the “dual dividend” of delighting customers and ensuring employee success. Additionally, it’s important to look towards the future by preparing for advanced multi-agent environments, robotics, and enterprise general intelligence (EGI). Learn how to get started in our step-by-step guide here . What is an AI agent? An AI agent is an intelligent reasoning application that can use data and large language models to conduct planning, task execution, and conversations. An agent takes action based on a trigger, which can be changes in data, conversations, and scheduled automations. It then uses that trigger to determine a plan of action. The plan of action is determined by the predefined topics assigned to an agent. A topic is a job to be done, complete with the instructions and set of actions the agent can execute to achieve that goal. The agent then reasons through the query, selects a relevant topic, selects the action to take, and gathers the data required to execute. Agentforce is the platform where IT teams can define the following parameters for their AI agents. Is Customer 360 a product? Customer 360 is not one specific product; it’s an end state we help our customers achieve by using the breadth of our portfolio. We offer apps for virtually every team within your organization, which means everyone — your employees and AI agents — can take action on a 360-degree view and is united around the customer to manage and grow customer relationships. How does Salesforce create a 360-degree view of my customer if our data is living in silos and disparate systems? Disconnected data is a top barrier to great customer and employee experiences. Too often it sits in disconnected silos, cut off from the trusted source of truth your organization needs. The answer is Data 360 , which unifies all your data from any source into a comprehensive, trusted view of your business. MuleSoft , the world’s #1 integration and API platform, connects data from anywhere (yes, even mainframes) so you can unite all your islands of data to get a complete view of your customers and business. And with our Zero Copy Partner Network , organizations can easily connect and use all their data within the Agentforce 360 Platform without needing to move or copy data between platforms. Once your data is unified, Tableau helps to explore data, uncover patterns, and act on insights across your business. Together, our data solutions give employees and agents governed real-time intelligence — ensuring they only access the data they’re authorized to use — while still enabling more personalized experiences at every touchpoint. What is Agentforce? Agentforce is Salesforce’s groundbreaking suite of customizable agents and tools, deeply integrated with the Agentforce 360 Platform that helps companies build, customize, and deploy autonomous agents to support employees and customers. With Agentforce, you can get out-of-the-box templates for quickly building and customizing AI agents that meet specific business requirements. These agents can also be personalized using familiar Salesforce tools, including prompt templates, Flows, and Apex. Agents are able to carry out business tasks using a company’s CRM data, external data, and metadata while adhering to strict privacy and security guidelines and action guardrails. Because these agents are completely integrated with your Customer 360 apps across sales, service, marketing, commerce, and more, they can seamlessly hand off to employees right in the flow of work. You can collaborate with your agents as a true extension of your team in any Salesforce app, partner app, or custom app you build. I’m just looking to get started with CRM and don’t think I need AI solutions yet. Is Salesforce right for me? Yes. Our CRM apps are designed to meet you exactly where you are today and help you embrace the latest technologies. Some organizations may just need one of our market-leading CRM solutions to support a single department or business goal, while others may benefit from connecting more of their teams and data on an AI-powered CRM platform to manage customer relationships more holistically. How do I know Salesforce can deliver results for my business? We’re proud of the results our customers see with Salesforce. But you don’t have to take our word for it. A customer survey completed in August 2025 revealed 97% of our customers achieved positive ROI with Salesforce and 98% were satisfied with Salesforce. On average, customers report a 34% faster response to customers, 33% faster decision-making, 33% faster collaboration, and 34% increase in employee productivity, among other metrics, across their entire Salesforce implementation. Read our customer success stories to learn more about the value Salesforce provides. How is Salesforce priced? We offer a variety of pricing options for our customers, including: Starter Suite, Pro Suite, or Foundation Suites: When you select a suite, you get a bundle of some of our most popular features in one package to create a Customer 360 out of the box across sales, service, marketing, commerce, and Data 360. Starter Suite is great for startups, whereas Foundations provides a more robust set of features for more established businesses. Add-ons: Each add-on you select helps you customize your CRM solution to get exactly what your organization needs. We offer add-ons with different tiers of functionality, which is similar to how our editions have varying levels of functionality for most products. To learn more, please visit the Salesforce Product Pricing page. Is AI included in all Salesforce apps and solutions? Customers must purchase product-specific add-ons to take advantage of Agentforce and other generative AI capabilities embedded within Salesforce clouds. However, many predictive AI features are offered as add-ons to our standard cloud editions. Get in touch with our sales team to learn more. Does Salesforce integrate with other applications? How? Salesforce CRM apps are deeply integrated, as they operate from one core platform with one metadata framework that creates a common language across apps. This means you can customize something in one app — for example, a custom object specific to your business like a “pet name” for an animal hospital or a “vehicle” for a car dealership — and that same customization can appear across every other app, automatically. In addition, Salesforce is open to external apps and technologies by design, because we never want to box our customers into solutions. Our platform is built to provide a seamless back-end experience with any external partner, model, data store, or productivity suite you currently use. We also operate a robust SaaS marketplace, AgentExchange, where partners build custom apps to extend your use of Salesforce. You can also integrate any system with Salesforce thanks to MuleSoft, the world’s #1 integration and API platform owned and operated by Salesforce. With the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform™, you can connect any system, application, data, and device to unleash the full power of the #1 AI CRM. And we know how important unified data is to trusted AI, so we make it easy to bring in any external data to Salesforce with our Zero Copy Partner Network . Zero copy enables organizations to easily connect and use all of their data within the Agentforce 360 Platform without needing to move or copy data between platforms. Learn more about zero copy here . How are Salesforce AI solutions different from public generative AI models? Public generative AI models can do amazing things, but the model learns from everything you enter into your prompts. That’s why enterprise AI is different — you certainly can’t have public models learning from your sensitive customer data. Salesforce helps you harness AI to deliver impactful customer experiences across your business with data privacy and security built in. Our Einstein Trust Layer prevents sensitive data from leaving the Salesforce trust boundary, so you can use AI in every app, across every user, and in every workflow across your CRM with confidence. Learn more about how Salesforce AI delivers trusted, extensible AI grounded in the fabric of our Agentforce 360 Platform . Where can I learn more about Salesforce products? If you haven’t already, be sure to watch our latest demos of Salesforce in action. Continue learning about all the incredible solutions that help companies become an Agentic Enterprise by exploring the product pages of our website.
